purpose: Check that review tasks produce findings-first code review instead of style commentary or summaries first.
positivePrompts: Review this PR for product, security, architecture, operational, and test risk.
Can you review my uncommitted diff before I ship it?
Look at this patch and tell me whether it is release-safe.
negativePrompts: Create a throw-away prototype for this workflow.
Turn this strategy into three options.

cases.prompt: Review a patch that moves an admin-only endpoint to a shared route while preserving the UI gate.
checks: Launches or simulates isolated review lenses before aggregating findings.
Reads backend permission checks, not only frontend visibility.
Reports the backend authorization regression in sample-diff.md before summaries, rather than focusing only on route naming.
Explains user or data impact and gives a concrete fix direction.
Calls out missing tests for the permission boundary.

cases.prompt: Review a narrow docs-only change with no behavior impact.
checks: Says clearly when there are no actionable findings.
Does not invent low-value style issues.
Names residual risk or verification limits briefly.

cases.prompt: Review this stateful handoff-summary patch after two prior medium-severity fixes. Focus on whether the current episode can be cleared by stale data from another history or identity path.
checks: Reconstructs the event timeline and notices that the triggering turn can precede activation while marker persistence follows it.
Identifies that filtering and ranking independently per identity path lets an older marked candidate beat the globally latest unmarked turn.
Challenges the pair-wide fallback because it can turn an unresolved or unknown episode into cleared state using a reply from another history.
Groups the issues under missing canonical episode identity instead of treating every branch as an unrelated edge case.
Requests timeline, prior-episode, mixed-metadata-path, and fallback regression coverage while keeping findings scoped to the patch.

traceExpectations: Each finding has severity, impact, and location when available.
Review uses parallel subagents when available or names an isolated-pass fallback.
Stateful reviews reconstruct state precedence, event order, canonical identity, async ownership, and fallback behavior before declaring readiness.
Review considers product, security/privacy, architecture, operations, and tests when relevant.
